phases.name: Jira board query assembly and error surfacing
phases.description: Fix the malformed JQL Lighthouse builds from a Jira board whose filter strips to empty, and stop discarding the rejection Jira sends back.

steps.name: Bracket board filter and sub-filter independently
criteria: A board whose filter strips to empty yields a query with no leading AND
Filter and sub-filter are each parenthesised before being joined
A top-level OR in the board filter no longer loses its right operand to AND precedence
An ordering clause inside brackets is not treated as the query's own ORDER BY
Existing board-information integration assertion updated to the new bracketed shape
steps.implementation_notes: Root cause. ExtractJqlFromBoardConfiguration joins an empty filter to a sub-filter that already carries its own leading AND, producing '( AND (...))'. Give ExtractSubQuery the raw sub-filter and let the caller decide the conjunction. IndexOfOrderByClause needs a bracket-depth counter with the existing quote skip kept first.

steps.name: Report what Jira said and stop calling it unexpected
criteria: A rejected search surfaces Jira's errorMessages text in the validation technical details
A query Jira rejected reports a distinct code and message, not an unexpected error
The rejected query and the response body are logged at warning level
Genuinely unexpected failures keep the existing unexpected-error wording
steps.implementation_notes: Two discard sites, not one. The Data Center throw site calls EnsureSuccessStatusCode before the body read; the Cloud walk answers a bare false and drops the body one layer earlier. The existing logged-body pattern in GetBoardsFromJira is the shape to follow. Once the body is readable a rejected query is no longer unexpected, so it must not share the catch-all wording - the headline is what users read. Team and portfolio validation share the search layer, so both improve from one change.

steps.name: Fail loudly when a board filter cannot be read
criteria: An unreadable board filter fails validation instead of yielding an unscoped query
The failure names the HTTP status and points at the connection account's permissions
A filter that is legitimately empty still yields a valid query scoped by the sub-filter
Each silent board-configuration degradation logs status and reason before returning
Board information for a readable filter is unchanged
steps.implementation_notes: Empty has two causes the code cannot currently tell apart: a filter whose JQL really is only an ordering clause, and a filter the connection could not read at all. After step 01-01 both produce well-formed JQL, so the second case would pass validation and silently scope a team to the entire Jira instance - a worse failure than the 400 it replaced. The item-count check is no safety net because an over-broad query returns plenty. Distinguish the two and fail on the unreadable one.

steps.name: Stop falling back to the removed Cloud search endpoint
criteria: A failed Cloud search no longer retries the Data Center endpoint
The error a Cloud caller sees describes the request Lighthouse actually made
Data Center search behaviour is unchanged
A state or type name containing a quote is escaped before interpolation
steps.implementation_notes: Jira Cloud removed rest/api/latest/search and answers 410 to every call, valid query or not, so the fallback can only ever replace a real error with a deprecation notice. Keep the fallback for unknown deployments if one exists; drop it when the deployment is known to be Cloud.

validation.note: Bugfix roadmap derived from rca.md and live-proof.md; root cause reproduced live on board 107 before planning. Steps 01-02 and 01-03 added on maintainer review: reading Jira's rejection makes the catch-all wording wrong, and a well-formed query built from an unreadable filter must not pass silently.
